recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. If source/careplan/careplan-example-asthma.xml is ever reactivated, update it as a separate whole-example cleanup against current schemas rather than treating that dormant file as an incomplete FHIR-12090 application.
issue_request: FHIR-12090 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Patient Care change request for FHIR-core Goal, raised from QI-Core #16 in DSTU2. It asked to resolve the clash between the old goal-target extension and Goal's target/date representation; the final resolution was to move goal-target into the Goal resource as a Target backbone element with measure, detail, and due child elements.
initial_application: The January 2017 application commit bd819cfbf9a33c335e7030ff69591f11f7a57882 moved the old goal-target extension content into the Goal spreadsheet and updated the main Goal and CarePlan examples to use Goal.target instead of the extension. Current source migration preserved that application in source/goal/structuredefinition-Goal.xml.
additional_context: Goal is active in source/fhir.ini, and current source/goal/structuredefinition-Goal.xml carries a GF#12090 committee note while defining Goal.target, measure, detail[x], and due[x]. Later final issues intentionally changed the original 2017 shape: FHIR-12585 added the measure-if-detail invariant, FHIR-12661 added the example binding, FHIR-17572 changed Goal.target to 0..*, FHIR-17753 added more detail[x] types, and FHIR-46293 removed an orphaned detail binding. The only residual non-history goal-target extension use is in an unreferenced stale CarePlan asthma XML file; the FHIR Extension Pack has no goal-target definition.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit and made no source change. The active Goal StructureDefinition already implements the migration as modified by later decisions, and editing the dormant unlisted asthma example would not improve the current built specification.

related_jiras.note: Added the invariant requiring Goal.target.measure when Goal.target.detail is populated.
Added the example binding for Goal.target.measure.
Changed Goal.target from 0..1 to 0..* and added multi-target semantics.
Added additional Goal.target.detail[x] data types after the original migration.
Removed an orphaned Goal.target.detail binding in current R6 source.
